# NSU Academics

> Comprehensive academic portal for Northeastern State University covering degree programs, departments, online learning, and professional development across multiple colleges and schools.

NSU Academics serves as the central hub for exploring NSU's diverse academic offerings, from traditional on-campus degrees to flexible online and continuing education programs. The site organizes content across multiple colleges and departments, with emphasis on distance learning, professional certifications, and specialized programs including ROTC, criminal justice, and indigenous studies.

## Key Topics

- Degree Programs
- Online Learning
- Continuing Education
- Professional Development
- Academic Advisors
- Certificates
- Internships
- NSU Online
- College of Liberal Arts
- College of Extended Learning
- Faculty Development
- Student Resources
- Departments Directory
- Bachelor Degrees
- Academic Centers

## Academic Structure & Navigation

- [Academic Colleges and Departments](https://academics.nsuok.edu): NSU academic structure directory covering colleges, departments, centers, and advising.
- [College of Liberal Arts](https://academics.nsuok.edu/liberalarts/default.aspx): Liberal Arts college departments, degrees, ROTC, and campus locations.
- [College of Extended Learning](https://academics.nsuok.edu/extendedlearning/default.aspx): Extended learning degrees including criminal justice, CLEET credit, and certificates.

## Online & Distance Learning

- [NSU Online | Northeastern State University](https://academics.nsuok.edu/online): NSU Online distance education degrees, certificates, and flexible learning programs.
- [NSU Online - Faculty Development](https://academics.nsuok.edu/nsuonline/default.aspx): Faculty development resources for online teaching and Quality Matters certification.

## Professional Development & Continuing Education

- [Continuing Education](https://academics.nsuok.edu/continuingeducation/default.aspx): Continuing education, professional development, tech boot camps, and career training.

## Education & Human Services

- [Department of Curriculum and Instruction](https://academics.nsuok.edu/curriculuminstruction/default.aspx): Education programs including early childhood, elementary, and special education.
- [Department of Psychology and Counseling](https://academics.nsuok.edu/psychologycounseling/default.aspx): Psychology and counseling degree programs with academic advising resources.
- [School of Social Work](https://academics.nsuok.edu/socialwork/default.aspx): Social Work BSW degree, field education, scholarships, and Native American focus.

## Health, Kinesiology & Criminal Justice

- [Health and Kinesiology](https://academics.nsuok.edu/healthkinesiology/default.aspx): Health and Kinesiology degrees, sport management, and Riverhawk Sport Performance.
- [Criminal Justice and Legal Studies](https://academics.nsuok.edu/criminaljustice/default.aspx): Criminal Justice degrees with law enforcement, cybersecurity, and internships.

## Liberal Arts Departments

- [Department of Languages and Literature](https://academics.nsuok.edu/languagesliterature/default.aspx): Languages and Literature degrees, ESL Academy, creative writing, and study abroad.
- [Communication Studies Program](https://academics.nsuok.edu/communicationstudies/default.aspx): Communication Studies BA and minor, forensics team, and Communication Lab.
- [Media Studies Program](https://academics.nsuok.edu/mediastudies/default.aspx): Media Studies degree with journalism, PR, multimedia, and internship options.
- [Geography & Political Science](https://academics.nsuok.edu/gps/default.aspx): Geography, Political Science, Global Studies, and GIS certificate programs.
- [History Programs](https://academics.nsuok.edu/history/default.aspx): History major, social studies education, and public history certificate.
- [Bachelor of Arts in Sociology](https://academics.nsuok.edu/sociology/default.aspx): Bachelor of Arts in Sociology with degree requirements and learning outcomes.
- [NSUArt](https://academics.nsuok.edu/art/default.aspx): Art degrees including studio art, graphic design, and BFA in Tahlequah.

## Optional

- [Cherokee Indigenous Studies Department](https://academics.nsuok.edu/cherokeeindigenous/default.aspx): Cherokee and indigenous studies degrees and cultural programs at NSU.
- [MILITARY SCIENCE and NSU ROTC: The RiverHawk Battalion](https://academics.nsuok.edu/rotc/default.aspx): Army ROTC officer commission, scholarships, and leadership training programs.
